    {"source_unit_id": "P1", "text": "The high-rise building operation system consists of the disaster prevention center, the building energy management system (BEMS), 2 emergency generators, 24 elevators, and the emergency broadcast system. The BEMS monitors power usage by floor."},
    {"source_unit_id": "P2", "text": "Externally there are KEPCO and the fire station; facility operation is handled by the facility manager, and elevator rescue by the elevator maintenance team."},

    {"source_unit_id": "P5", "text": "The disaster prevention center queries the status of the 24 elevators and identifies 3 stopped elevators. The disaster prevention center requests rescue from the elevator maintenance team and makes a guidance announcement to the trapped passengers through the emergency broadcast system."},

    {"source_unit_id": "P7", "text": "If the load factor of emergency generator No. 1 is 90% or more, the BEMS additionally starts emergency generator No. 2. At 6:40 p.m., when the load factor rises to 92%, the BEMS starts emergency generator No. 2."},
    {"source_unit_id": "P8", "text": "KEPCO replies to the disaster prevention center that a circuit breaker failure at a nearby substation is the cause and that restoration will take about 1 h."},
    {"source_unit_id": "P9", "text": "If the power outage exceeds 1 h 30 min, the facility manager notifies the tenant companies of an advisory to leave work. On this day the power outage ended after 1 h 10 min, so the advisory to leave work was not issued."},
    {"source_unit_id": "P10", "text": "At 7:20 p.m., when external power is restored, the BEMS returns the load to external power and stops the 2 emergency generators."},
    {"source_unit_id": "P11", "text": "The facility manager restarts the 24 elevators one after another, and the disaster prevention center ends the emergency broadcast after confirming that all elevators are operating normally."},
    {"source_unit_id": "P12", "text": "The disaster prevention center compiles the power outage response record and submits it to the fire station."},
    {"source_unit_id": "P13", "text": "The goal of this scenario is to rescue all trapped passengers within 30 min without casualties."}
